# Imran Buhari — Product Manager

> Imran Buhari builds user-centered products with empathy at the core. He takes ideas from ideation to MVP launch, and every decision along the way is backed by real human data. Open to product manager roles (full-time or contract) and freelance projects; works remote.

## Products
- [Sprint Maestro](https://sprintmaestro.lovable.app/): AI tool that turns PRDs into sprint-ready plans; cuts sprint-planning time by about 80%. Case study: https://imran-buhari.netlify.app/sprint-maestro
- [Tiqra](https://tiqra-mvp.vercel.app/): validation platform giving founders a Proceed / Pivot / Kill recommendation from verified human feedback and AI feasibility reports. Case study: https://imran-buhari.netlify.app/tiqra
- [AgroLynk](https://agrolynk.lovable.app/): mobile-first agritech MVP connecting smallholder farmers to markets, shaped by interviews with farmers and agricultural students; hackathon winner 2025. Case study: https://imran-buhari.netlify.app/agrolynk

- ProjectPilot: planning assistant for student teams; Product Owner for a remote team of 8; Fuse Varsity capstone (2026).
- Ceeravo: healthcare platform (in development) helping people reach the right hospital; leading a team of 23.
- Edukate UIL: installable web-app learning platform replacing WhatsApp for a university faculty's course materials (2026).
